notes: Shelf 'Grand & country houses' built from scratch (no old kinds on this shelf). All eight planned kinds delivered: Mansion, Country house, Château, Castle & tower house, Palazzo, Chalet, Hacienda & estancia, Hunting & fishing lodge. Archetypes are maker-free named house patterns (mk empty) sourced from English Wikipedia pages retrieved this session via web_fetch or the wiki tool; famous houses appear only as versions where they define a pattern (The Breakers, Biltmore, Hardwick Hall, Villa La Rotonda, Palazzo Medici Riccardi, Château Margaux, Jagdschloss Grunewald, Versailles pavillon). Years left blank where the retrieved page did not state them (Hearst Castle, Ca' d'Oro, Hôtel Lambert etc.). Iberian forerunners (cortijo, quinta, pazo, finca, bastide/mas) kept as archetypes or types because luxury buyers search by those names; the Regional house traditions shelf should cross-link rather than duplicate. Schloss sits under Castle & tower house as the plan directs, although Wikipedia treats it as the château/manor equivalent. Tenure and operating variants (catered chalet, ski-in/ski-out, piano nobile apartment, hacienda casco) are attribute types in t, not kinds. Brands and traditions are empty: houses have no makers in the brand-register sense and no artisan craft tradition applies to this shelf. Mega-mansion, Italian castello and Neuschwanstein had no usable retrieved page and are mentioned only as types/aliases. Wiki tool failed (lock error) after the first batch, so later pages were retrieved via web_search + web_fetch.
